text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Unusual SSO auth volume detected on auth-proxy-prod (us-west-2). 310 req/min (baseline ~6). Spike started ~2398765400. Event id: alert-8f3b. Potential replay/proxy abuse.

eli (oncall): paging @shreya @security-sam. I'm looking. Any quick customer impact numbers?

shreya: seeing lots of 401s then 200s with identical id_token jti and identical iat across many requests. pattern: same jwt reused across different source IPs. sample log:```
2026-03-15T22:50:07Z auth-proxy[pod-13] INFO auth.validate uid=uid:342 jti=3f9a... ip=18.205.4.12 ua="okhttp/3.12.1" status=200 trace=tr-9c2
```

ops-bot: quick enrichment: top 5 source IPs: [18.205.4.12, 34.210.11.9, 3.121.77.4, 54.173.2.190, 44.210.3.5]. Geo: multiple AZs/us-west. Reverse DNS: mixed cloud providers.

customer-ana: I'm not seeing open support cases yet. I'll prep a one-liner for customers if we confirm impact. Which tenant groups are hitting the proxy? any dedicated customers?

shreya: majority are from hosted-api frontends hitting the SSO handshake endpoint /oauth/callback and /session/refresh. A handful of requests include header x-customer-id: cust-042 and cust-981 (maybe Dedicated routing).

security-sam: stop-gap: add a WAF rate limit on /oauth/callback for 1 req/sec per IP, block the top 5 suspicious IPs at edge, and rotate the oauth client secret used by auth-proxy in 10 minutes window. Need infra to orchestrate.

infra-jordan: on it. Patching WAF rule now:```bash
aws wafv2 update-rate-based-rule --id rule-ssospike --rate-limit 1 --scope REGIONAL --region us-west-2
```
Applying blocklists to cloud-nat via firewall. Will also cordon a few auth-proxy pods for debugging:```bash
kubectl label pod auth-proxy-13 maintenance=true -n prod
```

eli (oncall): while that's in progress, can we revoke active sessions for suspected customers? script to batch revoke by jti?

shreya: yes. We have revoke endpoint: POST /admin/sessions/revoke batch body: {"jti_list": ["3f9a...","4b2c..."]}. Quick command:```bash
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"jti_list":["3f9a...","4b2c..."]}' https://auth-admin.internal/prod/admin/sessions/revoke
```
I'll assemble top jti set and push.

security-sam: hold on rotation until we identify if client secret was leaked vs token replay. If client secret is compromised we rotate immediately and force short TTL on session tokens. Proposed plan:
1) Implement WAF and blocklists (infra).
2) Revoke session JTIs observed in logs (shreya).
3) Rotate oauth client secret and new secret rollout to auth-proxy (infra + ops).
4) Force session TTL to 5m for high-risk routes (config rollback after 2h).

infra-jordan: WAF rule deployed, blocklists pushed, and I placed a short maintenance label on two suspect pods for live inspection. Observability: I'm pulling packet capture of inbound connections to auth-proxy-13 -> s3://redwood-internal/pcaps/2398765432.pcap (encrypted).

ops-bot: automation note: kicked off background job revoke-script-239876 to call admin revoke endpoint for top 200 jtis. ETA ~45s. Logs: revoke-script-239876 started, 27/200 succeeded so far.

shreya: confirmed the reused jtis are in that set, revokes are reducing successful 200s by ~40% in the last 30s.

eli (oncall): customer-ana, flag cust-042 and cust-981 as potentially impacted (sessions possibly hijacked). Ana, recommend: initial customer outreach: "We're investigating unusual authentication activity affecting some sessions. We're revoking sessions and recommending users re-auth. We'll provide an update in 60 minutes." Can you send?

customer-ana: will draft now. sending to SRE legal/security for signoff. ETA 10m.

security-sam: note: we should rotate the service account token used by the external SSO integration (sso-client-service) before we push secret to prod. Sequence: generate secret, deploy to staging, smoke test, then cut over and kill old secret.

infra-jordan: issuing new secret: secret-rot-239876 created in vault path secret/data/prod/sso-client-service. I'll trigger deploy:```bash
kubectl set env deployment/auth-proxy SSO_CLIENT_SECRET=$(vault read -field=value secret/data/prod/sso-client-service) -n prod
```
Deploying to canary 10% first.

eli (oncall): good. After rotate we need to ensure fallback: if any customers fail we can revert to old secret for 5 minutes while we troubleshoot. Also need to preserve audit trail.

shreya: added trace hook to all auth requests for next 30m: trace-id header enforced and sampled to full logs. Snapshotting ~5k traces to s3 for forensics.

ops-bot: revoke job completed: 200/200 jtis attempted, 196 succeeded, 4 failed (timeouts). Retrying failed set now.

security-sam: I want an incident ticket with severity P1, note potential session compromise. Assign to oncall-eli and security-sam. Create incident doc and add runbook steps — will append to the doc as we go.

eli (oncall): incident doc link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2398765432 (created). Adding chronology and actions so far.

customer-ana: initial customer template approved by security/legal. Sending to affected tenants now with recommend: logout & re-login, rotate any stored tokens, enable MFA where available.

shreya: traffic dropping ~85% after WAF + revokes + blocklist. A small tail remains (~50 r/min) coming from a rotating set of IPs. Possibly credential stuffing with a replay proxy.

security-sam: next actions: 1) throttle refresh endpoint for hosts not seen in normal fingerprint sets, 2) require short-lived nonce on callback, 3) check audit logs for admin token usage.

infra-jordan: can do throttle via ingress: patch applied to ingress rule to require header X-FP-ID for refresh endpoint and rate-limit for unknown FP ids.

eli (oncall): if post-rotation traffic stabilizes we will move to monitoring state in 60 minutes. If we see resurgence >30 r/min after mitigations, escalate to exec oncall.

ops-bot: scheduled a follow-up action item at 2398766000 to review logs and close or escalate.

security-sam: documenting IOCs: suspicious IP list, reused jtis list, user-agent "okhttp/3.12.1" pattern, and the oauth client id in question. Will handoff to forensics for deeper correlation.

customer-ana: affected customers notified (cust-042, cust-981). Support channel opened: #cust-cases-239876.

eli (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall @shreya and security-sam at 2398765560. I'll remain reachable for exec questions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

shreya: leaving notes in incident doc with commands run and S3 pcap locations. Follow-up tasks: rotate any long-lived session tokens for Dedicated tenants, run postmortem in 24h.

security-sam: will start forensic pull and scope whether any logs were exfiltrated. tagging retention for high-fidelity traces.

incident-bot: Incident 2398765432 moved to "Mitigated - monitoring" by eli (oncall).
